contextBefore.narration: It operates exactly like gravity. If a profoundly good person and a deeply evil person both step off the edge of a roof, gravity pulls them both down equally at the
exact same speed. Gravity doesn't care if you were a saint. It doesn't care if you deserve to fall. It is not a punishment.
That's just gravity, right? The law of attraction in this text is not a cosmic judge handing down sentences for bad thoughts.

beats.narration: It is a completely neutral mechanical response to where attention has been paid over time.
Whether that attention was deliberate or entirely unconscious. So it's a mechanical response,
not a verdict. Like if I accidentally touch a hot stove, my burned hand isn't a moral punishment from the universe for being a bad person.
It's just a mechanical physical response to touching heat. Exactly. When you remove the moral blame,
it ceases to be a cruel trap and actually becomes the ultimate empowerment mechanism. And well, how is that empowering?
Because it means that no matter what terrible thing has manifested, even illness, even trauma, even poverty, you still possess the mechanical ability to shift your point of attraction starting right
now simply by shifting your attention. Which brings us to the ultimate realization of this entire deep dive.
The whole hour we've spent breaking down radios and brass compasses and tight ropes and toy store windows
all distills down to this exact reframing. The feeling you have right now is not a verdict on your life.
It is the next reading of your own compass.
